bearingSource: OSM way 867758612 long axis 131°; +X points to the altar (east). Both ends are polygonal (ro.wikipedia: polygonal west apse of the porch), and photos 01 and 02 place the tower close to the altar cone
approximations: Overall size follows ro.wikipedia (35 × 9.5 m, about 42 m high). Wall height (≈ 16 m), ridge (≈ 20 m) and tower stages are scaled from photo 01 against that total; tower position (≈ 4.9 m west of the altar apse centre) and the ridge cross over the pronaos are read from photo 01. North and south elevations are modelled identically; the west end and porch are interpreted from the outline and the description. Carved stone ornament is reduced to mouldings, rope belts and niche frames; pilaster count, window positions and the star bases of the tower are estimated. Both photographs predate the 2010–2012 copper roofs, so the copper is shown in an aged dark-brown tone instead of the grey of the photos. Ensemble: ro.wikipedia records that the 2010–2012 restoration also re-roofed the monastery buildings, towers and wall-walks in copper, so the precinct is included at low detail — the enclosure walls (≈ 9.6 m to the wall-walk) with outer buttresses, a loopholed parapet and the copper-roofed wall-walk, the four corner towers (the north tower the tallest, ≈ 30 m) and the gate tower with its narrower side tower on the south-west wall, the two-storey north-east range and the lower north-west and south-west ranges with hipped copper roofs, small dormers and chimneys. Positions from OSM (city wall way 500861157, defensive-tower and city-gate nodes, range way 1231452330) checked against the Esri imagery; heights and roof pitches estimated from photos 01 and 02, which predate the copper and show these roofs in grey; tower windows, buttress spacing, dormers and chimneys are simplified.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după două fotografii mai vechi și după dimensiunile publicate (35 × 9,5 m, cca 42 m înălțime): înălțimea zidurilor și treptele turlei sunt estimate, iar decorul sculptat în piatră este simplificat. Fotografiile sunt anterioare învelitorii din cupru (2010–2012), de aceea cuprul este redat într-o nuanță brun-închisă, patinată. Sunt incluse, simplificat, și zidurile de incintă cu drumul de strajă acoperit, turnurile de colț, turnul porții și corpurile de chilii, care au primit același cupru la restaurarea din 2010–2012.
note.hu: Két régebbi fotó és a közölt méretek (35 × 9,5 m, kb. 42 m magasság) alapján értelmezett makett: a falmagasság és a torony szintjei becsültek, a faragott kődíszítés egyszerűsített. A fotók a 2010–2012-es rézfedés előtt készültek, ezért a réz sötétbarna, öregedett árnyalatban jelenik meg. Egyszerűsítve a kerítőfalak a fedett gyilokjáróval, a saroktornyok, a kaputorony és a cellaszárnyak is szerepelnek, amelyek a 2010–2012-es felújításkor ugyanazt a rézfedést kapták.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from two older photographs and the published dimensions (35 × 9.5 m, about 42 m high): wall height and tower stages are estimated, and the carved stonework is simplified. The photographs predate the 2010–2012 copper roofs, so the copper is shown in an aged dark-brown tone. The enclosure walls with their covered wall-walk, the corner towers, the gate tower and the monastic ranges, which received the same copper in the 2010–2012 restoration, are included in simplified form.
